description: This file defines the 'Multiplexer' class which implements the 'ReporterV2' interface, managing multiple reporters for test reporting in Playwright. It includes methods for handling test lifecycle events, output streams, and report configuration, as well as utility functions for error handling.

classes.name: Multiplexer
classes.description: A reporter that multiplexes test events to multiple underlying reporters.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test suite.

methods.name: onReportEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of reporting.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report after all tests.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Called at the start of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Called at the end of a test step.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Indicates if reporters print to stdio.
